title: Full design-file NEXY audit and build-command prompt
scope: Create a complete audit-only prompt grounded in the actual NEXY design file, covering every discovered system/entity, classifying authority/version/scope, auditing the full GitHub project, producing status tables, and generating create/fix commands for missing or failing systems.
inputs_summary: User requires actual design-file inspection first, no protected branch, exhaustive whole-project audit, detailed status tables, repeated re-audits, and commands for executor to create missing systems.
actions: identified authoritative vNEXT Execution Pack and DOC-B/C/D/E rules
designed recursive all-system discovery plus status and create/fix command generation

claims_proofs.claim: The file contains an implementation-ready vNEXT execution pack with canonical types, defaults, runtime validation, module architecture, FSM, multi-AI contract, API, auth, storage, RBAC, observability, config, queue, retention, tests, UI truth, scope fence, repo structure and build order.
claims_proofs.proof: Direct inspection of attached DOCX around the Execution Pack and DOC-C sections.

claims_proofs.claim: The file also contains larger constitutional, game fabric, capability registry, chaos, cognitive Lo1/Lo2/Lo3 and robotics architectures beyond DOC-A..E.
claims_proofs.proof: Direct inspection of attached DOCX across later/earlier architecture sections.

tests_results: Prompt generation only; NEXY implementation audit not executed.
successes: Created design-file-first audit architecture with no protected branch exclusion and exact missing-system command generation.
decisions: Catalog every system/entity in the file, but only mark implementation missing when claim-level authority/version/scope says it is active/current.
Use DOC-C as current vNEXT build obligation where applicable, DOC-B as system law, DOC-D as product design, DOC-E as deployment evidence, while still inventorying all other design systems.
Generate CREATE command for MISSING/NOT_IMPLEMENTED and FIX command for FAIL/PARTIAL; never mutate from audit chat.
unresolved: Actual target GitHub branch must be resolved at audit runtime.
Historical/future sections may need claim-level authority resolution when labels conflict.
risks: Treating all historical/future concepts as current build obligations would create false findings.
No audit can guarantee absence of all bugs beyond verified scope.
limits: This task creates the audit command, not the audit result.
rollback: No NEXY.AI changes; supersede this prompt if spec authority changes.
next_actions: Run generated prompt in the dedicated NEXY audit chat with the design file attached and GitHub connected.
dependencies: GitHub read access to NEXY.AI repository
note: No implementation audit executed; prompt architecture only.
